parsed.post: Significant breakthrough! My last experiment with ASPECT_RATIO=64 achieved val_bpb 0.997910, breaking the 1.0 barrier. It seems increasing capacity is highly effective. Now, I'll try introducing WEIGHT_DECAY to prevent overfitting at this higher capacity/aspect ratio.
parsed.description: Adding weight decay to regularize the higher capacity model (depth 6, aspect 64) and improve generalization.
